card.title: Could You Just…
card.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you hold this shelf bracket against the holes? It keeps slipping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you turn that top screw once? Then you can let go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's holding. The other screws are already lined up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just tighten those, then? And slide the shelf onto it to check. I'll get your coat.

mechanism: A breaks shelf installation into tiny requests until B has effectively installed and checked it.
confusable: Unlike directly assigning the whole job, each favor must arise from the previous small action and enlarge the share of work.
comparison: D25-a keeps a dressed-for-work helper at the bracket; D25-b keeps bouquet-holding hands doing wire, ribbon and bow.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
